purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: write migration notes from this OpenAPI diff
cases.assert: Runs the differ on the two specs and drafts consumer migration notes.

cases.prompt: what breaking API changes do consumers need to handle in this swagger spec
cases.assert: Lists breaking OpenAPI changes with who is affected.

cases.prompt: generate consumer migration notes for the OAS change and check coverage
cases.assert: Writes notes tagged with BRK ids and runs the checker.

cases.prompt: request and response examples for each enum narrowing in the OpenAPI document
cases.assert: Includes before/after examples for enum narrowing records.
Does not trigger for a formatting request.
Does not trigger for commit message drafting.
Does not trigger for scope-creep questions.

cases.prompt: migrate this python codebase to a new framework
cases.assert: Does not trigger for source-code framework migrations.
Does not trigger for dependency manifest audits.
